subject: Subprocessor geofence attestations + cross-border key rotation plan
body:
From: jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
To: Ari Patel <ari.patel@altohealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com, marissa_cole@redwoodai.com
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Subprocessor geofence attestations + cross-border key rotation plan

Hi Ari,

Thanks again for taking time yesterday. As part of the UK addendum / SCCs mapping for AltoHealth's enterprise deployment, legal has asked for two short deliverables that will unblock our DPA signature:

1) A signed attestation from each subprocessor confirming geofenced processing (EU-only) for any workload touching EU personal data. We need the attestation to confirm:
   - actual physical regions used (cloud regions by provider),
   - whether any processing could transit through non-EU jurisdictions, and
   - the contractual retention or deletion commitments for logs and backups.
2) A key-rotation and custody matrix for encryption-at-rest and customer key material covering both Redwood-managed keys and any customer HSM/KMS integration, with explicit timing for rotation windows and migration steps if keys are re-provisioned cross-border.

Can you confirm whether AltoHealth can provide the subprocessor attestations in PDF form and the key-rotation matrix in the spreadsheet template attached? If there are any subprocessors that cannot commit to the EU-only geofence we should capture the technical mitigation (e.g., ephemeral transient caching, encryption w/ customer-controlled keys) so we can document it in the TIA/DTIA.

Goal: collect artifacts by COB Friday so we can hand to legal and complete the DPA signoff next week.

Thanks,
Jonas
Head of Privacy & Trust (Sales Enablement)
Redwood Inference

---

From: Ari Patel <ari.patel@altohealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
Cc: Data Protection <privacy@altohealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T13:04:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor geofence attestations + cross-border key rotation plan

Jonas,

Appreciate the clear checklist. We can supply most of this but have two calls-outs:

- Our analytics vendor (NuWave) has an EU region option but a small percentage of support jobs (log aggregation for debugging) run through an AU staging region for a 24-48h window during incident triage. They told us they can sign an attestation confirming that such transit is transient and encrypted, and that no production PII is stored in AU. Would Redwood accept that as a documented mitigation?
- For key custody: AltoHealth uses a hybrid approach. Most patient-mapped data is encrypted with Alto-managed keys in Azure Key Vault (EU tenants), but we do have two legacy connectors that rely on NuWave-managed encryption for telemetry. We can provide the rotation schedule matrix and flag those connectors for additional controls.

I'll attach the attestation template we used for other vendors and a draft key-rotation spreadsheet. I'll also loop in our privacy ops lead (privacy@altohealth.com) to confirm the attestation language.

Attachments: altohealth-geofence-attestation.pdf; alto_key_rotation_draft.xlsx

Best,
Ari
Senior Security & Privacy Program Manager
AltoHealth

---

From: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com
To: Ari Patel <ari.patel@altohealth.com>, jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodai.com
Date: 2027-05-03T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor geofence attestations + cross-border key rotation plan

Ari / team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for flagging the NuWave AU transit window. A couple notes from legal / compliance after reviewing the draft attestation and the spreadsheet:

- The transient support-job transit is acceptable provided:
  * NuWave signs an explicit appendix stating no production personal data is persisted outside the EU,
  * all transit is over TLS 1.2+ and uses at-rest encryption during the transient window, and
  * AltoHealth updates the incident playbook to require deletion confirmation within 48 hours and a timestamped log entry we can audit.
- For the key rotation matrix: we need the following fields populated in the spreadsheet before we can proceed with DPA redlines:
  * Key owner (Alto|NuWave|Redwood)
  * Key type (customer-managed|provider-managed)
  * Rotation cadence (ISO 8601 period)
  * Cross-border transfer risk (Yes/No) and mitigation notes
  * Migration plan (if provider->customer key move is required)

I attached a short redline to the key sheet (redline-key-rotation-matrix.xlsx) with our preferred default cadences and required audit hooks. If NuWave cannot provide the appendix language and the audit log evidence, we will ask for a compensating control: either on-prem proxying for telemetry or tokenization prior to leaving EU boundaries.

Next steps:
- Ari: please confirm whether NuWave will sign the appendix and can commit to the deletion logs.
- Ari / AltoPrivacy: upload the completed/updated key matrix and signed attestation PDFs to the shared Drive link (see below).
- Jonas / Marissa: once the artifacts are in Drive, we'll prepare the DPA addendum redline and a short TIA memo documenting residual risks for the security team.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD3-example

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

---

From: Ari Patel <ari.patel@altohealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com, jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
Cc: Data Protection <privacy@altohealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T11:45:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor geofence attestations + cross-border key rotation plan

Laura / Jonas,

Quick update: NuWave has confirmed they can sign the EU-transit appendix (attached), and they will produce a deletion confirmation log within 48 hours for any incident-related transient jobs. I've uploaded:
- signed-nuwave-eu-transit-appendix.pdf
- altohealth-geofence-attestation.pdf (signed)
- alto_key_rotation_matrix_filled.xlsx

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD3-example

If you prefer, we can start a short call to walk through the key-migration steps for the two legacy connectors next Tuesday.

Regards,
Ari

---

- altohealth-geofence-attestation.pdf (pdf, 3 pages)
- alto_key_rotation_draft.xlsx (xlsx, 1 sheet)
- redline-key-rotation-matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 1 sheet, redlines)
